ex.s: It contains around 163,000 words, plus word combinations and idiomatic phrases. ____39____ However, if I need to check the origin of a word or to look up examples of its usage, there's nothing better.
ex.t: 它收录了约16.3万个单词，外加词语搭配和惯用短语。____ 不过，如果我需要查一个单词的词源或查找其用法例句，没有比它更好的了。

defs.def: as well as sth/sb; and also 和；也；外加

ex.s: Today the temperature in London is expected to reach 30 plus degrees!
ex.t: 今天伦敦的气温预计将达到30多度！

ex.s: Pouring water was very difficult, plus I kept drinking from my friend's glass.
ex.t: 倒水非常困难，而且我还总喝我朋友杯子里的水。

ex.s: The channel features documentaries with factual content involving nature, science, culture and history, plus some reality and pseudo-scientific programmes.
ex.t: 这个频道以纪实性内容的纪录片为特色，涉及自然、科学、文化和历史，外加一些真人秀和伪科学节目。

ex.s: Plus, it also includes a free poster illustrating new plans to get rid of the Ebola virus once and for all.
ex.t: 此外，它还包括一张免费海报，说明一劳永逸地消灭埃博拉病毒的新计划。

ex.s: Everything changed when one day I came across the success story of a plus-size model, Tess Holliday.
ex.t: 当有一天我偶然看到大码模特泰丝\u00b7霍丽迪的成功故事时，一切都变了。

defs.def: an advantage; a good thing 优势；好处；长处
the symbol ( + ), used in mathematics 加号
above zero 零度以上；零上
slightly higher than the mark/grade A, B, etc. 用于评分或评等级
